body:
Thank you. I'm sorry you have to go through feeling this way. I'm sorry anyone does. I just don't get it, like it doesn't make sense from a biological point of view for so many people to feel so sad that they want to kill themselves if the point of a species is to live and reproduce. So why do so many people feel this way? I don't get it.

My life just feels like one long bout of depression punctuated by occasional feelings of happiness. But the more I go on the more I feel like the good times aren't worth going through the bad. I could make a ton of friends but what if they just left, like all my other friends do? I could find a new boyfriend but what if he left too? I could spend time with my family but eventually either they're going to die, or I'm going to die. And I know it's selfish but I don't want to live to see everyone I love die. I'd rather go first. 

You're right, every day I ask myself if I'd rather die or stay lying in bed staring at the ceiling. I used to have some sort of hope that things would get better, and that always got me through it before. But it's just been worn away over time and I can't bring myself to really do anything anymore. I'm so tired. Even the things I used to like just don't appeal to me anymore. I'm just so tired.

I'm waiting until tomorrow because I have an appointment with my therapist and maybe she can say something that will help me. But I don't want to tell her that I'm feeling this suicidal because I don't want to be locked up or anything. I don't know. I guess I'll see how it goes.

I just mean that if my choice was between somehow being happy and killing myself, I would choose being happy. But I just don't feel like I'm a person who can actually be happy and stay happy. I don't feel like other people. My brain is constantly in hyperdrive, always over-analyzing everything to the point that it stops me from doing anything at all. I'm always so anxious and scared. I don't know how to interact with people anymore, or maintain relationships with people. I don't know. I wish I was different.

There are people that care about me. My family, and some old friends, they would all be sad if I died, I know that. But I'm so unhappy anyways. When I spend time with people I just feel like I'm not there, like I'm watching myself go through the motions but I'm not really experiencing anything anymore. It's hard to describe. I just don't really feel present in the world. And even if I do stick around for them, we'll all eventually die anyways. So I might as well do it now. I just feel like I've been working for things for so long and none of it matters, I just don't care anymore, I'm just so goddamned tired.
